noise: Wear earplugs or noise-cancelling headphones during the loudest hours.
Grounding: breathe in for 1 and out for 1, then 2 and 2, up to 5 or 6.
Pick a room away from the street and keep the windows shut.
heat: Drink water every hour, even when you don't feel thirsty.
Use air conditioning if you have it, or go to a cooling center.
Keep blinds closed during the afternoon.
air: Stay indoors with the windows closed while the air is bad.
If you go out, wear a well-fitting mask (N95).
Keep any prescribed inhaler with you.
